name: ATTACHMENTDOLL
source:
According to Volks lore, Mother Super Dollfie gave birth to all Super Dollfies. In reality, she’s a statue of the Virgin Mary that sits in the atrium at Sato and selectively neglects chosen children to make those loved feel all the more special. 

[From [url=https://deaddeaddeath.neocities.org/attachmentdoll]the official site[/url]]
translation:
根据大众传说，超级娃娃妈妈生下了所有超级娃娃。事实上，她是一座圣母玛利亚的雕像，坐落在佐藤的中庭，有选择性地忽视选定的孩子，让那些所爱的人感到更加特别。

[来自[url=https://deaddeaddeath.neocities.org/attachmentdoll]官方网站[/url]]
